purpose: Teach: キュウリ/とうもろこし/にっこり/ガソリンスタンド/ホームセンター/クラスメート/うっすら/気さく

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、キュウリ、絶対、サンドイッチ、絶対、作ってあげるね
lines.en: Sho, I'm going to make you the best cucumber sandwiches, I promise you.
lines.style: Warm, genuine promise. Soft attack. Speaking directly to the child with unhurried tenderness. Slight lean-in on the repeated affirmation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、とうもろこし、絶対、ぼくの、絶対、お気に入りなんだ
lines.en: Mei-sis, you know what? Corn is actually my absolute favorite.
lines.style: Bright, earnest declaration. Quick tempo. The slight wonder of sharing something true. Small chest-forward energy—excited but not loud.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、にっこり、絶対、笑顔、絶対、可愛いわよ、メイ姉さん
lines.en: And Sho, when you smile like that—so genuine—it's the cutest thing. Really.
lines.style: Tender, genuine observation. Slow, deliberate. Noticing something real about him. Soft eye-crease in the voice. Not performing—seeing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ガソリンスタンド、絶対、車、絶対、洗えるところもあるよね
lines.en: Mei-sis, did you know some gas stations even have car washes? Like, you can wash the whole car there.
lines.style: Quietly marveling. Conversational but attentive—he's noticed something specific and wants to share it. Slight upward lift at the revelation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんと、本気で、絶対、ホームセンター、絶対、行きたい?翔くん
lines.en: Sho, would you like to go to the home center with me sometime? We could look around together.
lines.style: Warm invitation. Open, unhurried. Genuine question—not performing excitement but offering genuine time. Soft landing on his name.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼくの、絶対、クラスメート、絶対、紹介、絶対、したいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I actually want to introduce you to my classmates. They'd really like you.
lines.style: Proud but gentle. Clear and steady. A boy sharing something that matters. The slight vulnerability of wanting approval, held lightly.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 公園の桜、本気で、絶対、うっすら、絶対、色づいてきたわよ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, did you notice? The cherry blossoms in the park are starting to change color.
lines.style: Gentle observation shared. Soft attack. Drawing his attention to something small and lovely. Unhurried pace. Speaking as though noticing together.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、気さくで、絶対、お話、絶対、しやすいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis is really easy to talk to, you know? You make it feel so comfortable.
lines.style: Warm, earnest appreciation. Calm tempo. The relief of feeling safe with someone. Small smile beneath the words. Genuine, without performance.
